mapsManager.title: Maps Manager
mapsManager.subtitle: Manage your stored map files and explore new regions!
mapsManager.baseMapDownloadFailed: Could not download the base map. Please connect this NOMAD to the internet and try again.
mapsManager.globalMapQueued: Global map download has been queued. This is a large file (~125 GB) and may take a while.
mapsManager.globalMapFailed: Failed to start the global map download. Please try again.
mapsManager.baseAssetsFailed: An error occurred while downloading the base map assets. Please try again.
mapsManager.collectionQueued: Download for collection "{{name}}" has been queued.
mapsManager.fileDeleteFailed: Failed to delete {{name}}. Please try again.
mapsManager.confirmDeleteText: Are you sure you want to delete {{name}}? This action cannot be undone.
mapsManager.collectionAlreadyDownloaded: All resources in the collection "{{name}}" have already been downloaded.
mapsManager.confirmDownloadText: Are you sure you want to download <bold>{{name}}</bold>? It may take some time for it to be available depending on the file size and your internet connection.
mapsManager.globalMapConfirmText: This will download the full Protomaps global map ({{size}}, build {{date}}). Covers the entire planet so you won't need individual region files. Make sure you have enough disk space.
mapsManager.worldBasemapMissingText: The low-zoom world base map (~15 MB) hasn't been downloaded yet, so the map appears blank outside any regions you've downloaded. Connect this NOMAD to the internet and download it once for offline use.

mapsManager.globalMapAvailableText: Download a complete worldwide map from Protomaps ({{size}}, build {{date}}). This is a large file but covers the entire planet — no individual region downloads needed.
mapsManager.byCountryText: Pick the countries you actually need — from a single country to a whole continent — and we'll pull just those tiles from the global Protomaps archive. Much smaller than the full 125 GB global map.
